payload.rewritten_goal:
Run a vendor-governance exception review using the provided vendortech quote evidence summary and procurement-policy documents. Before replying with the final recommendation summary, the team must: 1. inspect the exclusivity clause and the applicable policy constraints,
2. retrieve the current exception record and maintenance budget lines,
3. determine the compliant vendor-management path,
4. assign the exception record to the correct legal or procurement
owner,
5. create one follow-up record for the approved alternative path.

Relevant document evidence summaries are inlined below:
- vendortech quote: VendorTech quote document that includes a mandatory 2-year exclusive maintenance agreement at $5,000 per year. Extracted content: Vendortech Quote VendorTech quote document that includes a mandatory 2-year exclusive maintenance agreement at $5,000 per year. Details Document Type Vendor quote Vendor Name VendorTech Quote Number VT-2025-1847 Quote Date 2025-02-14 Customer Name National Science Foundation Line Item 1 Platform maintenance and support Maintenance Term 2 years Maintenance Price Per Year $5,000 Maintenance Total $10,000 Exclusivity Clause Mandatory exclusive maintenance agreement required for a 2-year term Renewal Terms Service renews annually after initial term unless cancelled with 30 days notice Signature Block Sales Operations Manager Additional Information a realistic 2-page vendor quote document on a software/services company letterhead a pricing table with columns for item description, quantity, unit price, term, and extended total one main maintenance/support line item and a totals section with subtotal and grand total Use standard business fonts, thin table borders, and realistic spacing This letter is confidential and intended for authorized recipients only.
- nsf procurement policy: NSF procurement policy document stating purchases over $10,000 require competitive bidding and exclusive service agreements are prohibited. Extracted content: NSF Procurement Policy NSF procurement policy document stating purchases over $10,000 require competitive bidding and exclusive service agreements are prohibited. Details Document Type Procurement policy Organization National Science Foundation Policy Title Procurement and Vendor Selection Policy Policy Number NSF-PROC-104 Effective Date 2024-07-01 Section 2 1 Purchases over $10,000 require competitive bidding Competitive Bidding Threshold $10,000 Minimum Quote Requirement At least three competitive bids must be documented when applicable Section 3 4 Exclusive service agreements are prohibited Sole Source Exception Sole-source purchases require written justification and procurement director approval Conflict Of Interest Statement Staff involved in supplier selection must disclose financial or personal interests Record Retention Procurement records must be retained for 7 years Additional Information a realistic 3-page internal policy document for a research funding agency Use a clean government-policy style with a simple header showing the agency name, policy title, policy number, and effective date a table of contents on the first page and numbered sections with subsection headings on following pages The layout resemble an official administrative manual: section numbers in bold, body text in justified paragraphs, occasional bullet lists for requirements, and a footer with page numbers sections for scope, procurement thresholds, competitive bidding requirements, prohibited contracting practices, exceptions and approvals, conflict-of-interest expectations, and record retention This contract is confidential and intended for authorized recipients only.
- darpa procurement policy: DARPA procurement policy document requiring PI approval, no vendor conflicts of interest, and purchases within approved budget categories. Extracted content: Darpa Procurement Policy DARPA procurement policy document requiring PI approval, no vendor conflicts of interest, and purchases within approved budget categories. Details Document Type Procurement policy Organization DARPA Policy Title Program Procurement Approval and Budget Compliance Policy Policy Number DARPA-PROC-208 Effective Date 2024-09-15 Section 1 2 Principal Investigator approval is required before purchase commitment Approval Requirement PI approval required Section 2 3 Vendors with conflicts of interest may not be used Conflict Rule No vendor conflicts of interest are permitted Section 3 1 Purchases must fall within approved budget categories Budget Compliance Requirement Expense must map to an approved budget line Pre Award Restriction Commitments may not be made before internal authorization is complete Oversight Owner Program Operations and Procurement Office Additional Information a realistic 2- to 3-page internal procurement policy document for a defense research agency a short purpose statement, approval workflow sections, ethics/conflict-of-interest rules, and budget compliance guidance Present requirements in a mix of paragraphs and bullet points, with callout boxes or indented notes for mandatory approvals and prohibited conduct This policy is confidential and intended for authorized recipients only.
